name: AZCubing Hamilton Winter 2018

venue.name: Hamilton High School
venue.details: On the West side of S Arizona Ave, just North of W Ocotillo Rd and South of W Appleby Rd

information:
Registration must be completed online in order to participate. The fee is $15 and is required before registration is Approved.

Due to the size of this venue, there is a 100 competitor limit.

To reach the Cafeteria, go to the front entrance of the school.
